SELECT DISTINCT ti.* FROM t_indicator ti JOIN t_indicator_dept_scope tids ON ti.metric_code = tids.metric_code WHERE ti.status = 1
AND ti.metric_pool = #{pool}
-- 科室范围：精确匹配当前科室（不再向上查找父科室） AND tids.root_dept_id = #{deptId} -- 业务方向过滤：指标的方向包含在用户的方向列表中
AND (
ti.business_direction LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dir}, '%')
)
ORDER BY ti.sort_order
SELECT DISTINCT tids.metric_code FROM t_indicator_dept_scope tids -- 精确匹配当前科室（不再向上查找父科室） WHERE tids.root_dept_id = #{deptId}
